title: Uncovering Differences in Persuasive Language in Russian versus English Wikipedia

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying and comparing the frequency of persuasive and emotionally-charged language across paired Russian and English Wikipedia articles using an LLM-based identify-then-extract prompting strategy to highlight differing cultural perspectives.

Evaluating implicit bias and deviations from Neutral Point of View (NPOV) by measuring the density of persuasive text spans in different language editions (English and Russian) of the same Wikipedia subjects.
Grouping Wikipedia subjects into broader topics and ranking them by persuasion frequency to analyze differing political narratives and cross-cultural disagreements on geopolitical events.
